title: Eco-friendly synthesis of Ag/CeO2 and CuO/CeO2 nanocomposites using Curcuma longa extract and assessment of their antioxidant, antifungal, and cytotoxic activities
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,12100-12116
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA00739A, Paper
Open Access

Khaled M. Elattar, Abeer A. Ghoniem, Fatimah O. Al-Otibi, Abdulaziz S. Fakhouri, Yosra A. Helmy, WesamEldin I. A. Saber, Mahmoud A. E. Hassan, Ashraf Elsayed
Ag/CeO2 and CuO/CeO2 nanocomposites were synthesized using Curcuma longa extract and showed notable antioxidant, antifungal activity against M. phaseolina, and cytotoxicity toward MCF-7 cells.
